item.title: Sado Earth Celebration: Kodo's Thunderous Taiko Drumming Festival — Guide
item.description: Earth Celebration is an annual world music festival held each August on Sado Island, organised by Kodo, one of the world’s most acclaimed taiko drumming ensembles, who have made the island their base since the 1980s. The festival combines Kodo’s own thunderous, athletic taiko performances with international world music acts and collaborative workshops, all staged against Sado’s natural coastal and mountain scenery, drawing music fans from Japan and abroad for a uniquely immersive island festival experience.
